question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Omission
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Deletion'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Omission"** refers to something that has been left out or neglected.(छूट)'.

 
 
• **For example-** "The omission of her name from the list was a serious oversight by the committee".
 
 
 
• The most appropriate synonym for **'omission'** from the given options is **'deletion'. **
 
• **'Deletion'** means the removal of something that has been recorded. (हटाना).
 
 
• **For example-** "The unnecessary part was identified for deletion to simplify the text".
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Deletion'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Skipper':** It is a person who commands a ship or boat or in cricket could mean a team captain('कप्तान)
 
• **'Maintain'** means to cause or enable a condition to continue.(बनाए रखना)
 
• **'Accrual'** refers to the accumulation or increase of something over time.(उपार्जन)
